objective: Audit user stories and journeys for CLI, /app, Getting Started, tutorials, runbooks, companion website, criteria cards, results/downloads, onboarding, errors/recovery, branding/layout/typography/spacing/navigation, semantic math, no-JS boundaries, and browser-deferred limitations.
scope: /app server-rendered no-JS workflow (criteria, matrix, preview, compute, results)
Branding, layout, typography, spacing, navigation consistency
exclusions: Browser, assistive-technology, zoom, reflow, keyboard-execution, and offline/load execution

executed_evidence.command: pytest -q tests/test_docs_routes.py tests/test_app_workflow.py tests/test_module_docs.py tests/test_website_static.py tests/test_local_document_links.py tests/test_ui_styles.py tests/test_active_template_ui.py tests/test_preview_gate.py tests/test_dc45_criteria_cards.py tests/test_style_corrections.py tests/test_security_headers.py

key_findings.finding: Orphaned JSON-API flow (/preview/<id>, /compute/start) coexists with the real /app no-JS flow, undocumented as legacy; debugging.md section 1 describes the wrong gate/status code for the real /app journey.

CLI quickstart expected-output claims differ across cli_quickstart.md, GETTING_STARTED.html, and website/index.html for the same committed scenario without explaining the direct-CSV-vs-converted-NumPy identifier labeling difference.
/app wizard templates have no persistent navigation; mid-flow users have no visible escape hatch except browser Back.

Design tokens duplicated (not shared) across app/static/style.css and inline <style> blocks in docs/ and website/, with two materially different spacing scales and no sign-posted reason for the density shift.
Structured-criteria cards default to q=p=v=0 with no inline nudge to set deliberate thresholds before submit.
Bare Flask 404 for missing module docs gives no link back to /docs/modules.
highlight.js ships a ?debug=1 console-logging mode in the production-served asset (no sensitive data observed).

positive_findings_summary: 4-step wizard with explicit step indicators and in-context, field-specific error recovery
CSS-only criteria-card include/exclude toggle with non-color text badge cue
Checksum-verified, rate-limited, no-store download path with timeout/infeasibility handling that never publishes partial results
Semantic HTML math (entities, sup/sub) consistent with no-JS/offline/CSP-strict goals; no renderer-failure risk
Progressive enhancement pattern (:target CSS fallback plus optional JS) in module tutorials, with documented localStorage-failure handling
Consistent brand token vocabulary (color/radius/font) across /app, docs, and website despite duplication
Thorough static/keyboard-source test coverage (Enter/Space, aria-pressed, preventDefault, reduced-motion, missing-element guards)
limitations: No browser, assistive-technology, zoom, reflow, keyboard-execution, or offline/load evidence; all deferred and non-blocking per project policy
Static/source-level and test-assertion evidence only; not a substitute for browser execution
next_action: PI consolidates Engineering and UIUX audits, then commits the approved audit chunk after scope and clean-tree review.
